code:
joined = trips.join(
  zones, trips.PULocationID == zones.LocationID, "inner"
)
joined.select("VendorID", "fare_amount", "Zone", "Borough").show(5)
caption: Turns a numeric PULocationID into a real, readable Zone and Borough.

code:
trips.join(zones, cond, "inner")  # only matches on both sides
trips.join(zones, cond, "left")   # every trip, matched or null
trips.join(zones, cond, "right")  # every zone, matched or null
trips.join(zones, cond, "full")   # everything, from both sides
caption: "inner" is the default if omitted. "left" usually fits this dataset best.
